transcript: And back again for round 24. The last of the Max debuts this week with Ben Crawford going on as Max. And y'all, he killed it. What's been really fun this week is seeing not only all of the different maxes and all of the choices that they make and how they form their very different characters, but also getting to see all of them with Ashley Jenkins on as Lucy, and seeing how her performance adjusted depending on who she was opposite with for those scenes is fascinating. This is why I love live theatre. And one of the things that I love about getting to see all of the covers on is not just getting to see their vastly different choices, we're also getting to see all of the different costumes that they have designed for the show. Because it feels like every single character has a slightly different costume design that fits what they bring to that character. For example, when Ashley Jenkins goes on as Lucy, she has much more shorts and pants than Shoshana Bean's Lucy, who wears pretty much primarily skirts. Even some of their costumes are slightly different colours. It's details like that that keep the show interesting, as I keep coming back over and over again. Okay, but I was just thinking. And spoilers for The Lost Boys, so if you haven't seen the show yet, stop watching now. But are the suspects that the Frog brothers bring to Sam intentional nods To the fact that both of those characters are the characters that the two Max covers normally play. I was just thinking about this. Somebody let me know, cause it was. It was changed in previews.
classificationReason: Creator attended round 24, shares opinions about Ben Crawford's debut as Max, Ashley Jenkins' performance adjustments opposite different co-stars, and costume design details. Clear first-hand attendance and opinion.
